scoring_justification: Comparing agent-reported ΔG values to paper's hidden reference with tolerance ±0.2 eV and verifying ordering trend; recompute from raw DFT energies is infeasible in verifier.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from paper Figure 3 and associated text
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed directly from the paper's DFT results: rGO_basal=0.83, B_rGO_basal=-0.49, Nq_rGO_basal=-0.02, NB_rGO_B_atom=-0.81 (all in eV)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own computed ΔG values; they are the hidden gold for reproduction verification.

outputs.description: Gibbs free energy change ΔG for the rate-determining step (formation of two adsorbed OH*) on the basal-plane active sites of four models: pristine rGO, B-doped rGO, N-doped rGO (quaternary N), and N,B-codoped rGO (B adjacent to pyridinic N).

output_contract.notes: The values correspond to the paper's Figure 3 and associated text. The checker compares to hidden reference values within a tolerance appropriate for DFT code/functional differences, and also verifies the relative trend (NB_rGO_B_atom ≤ B_rGO_basal ≤ Nq_rGO_basal ≤ rGO_basal).

steps.description: Four ΔG values compared to hidden gold with tolerance and trend verification.
